description: This file is a shell script for testing shared repository initialization in Git. It contains various test cases that set up repositories with different permissions and configurations, verifying correct behavior of Git's shared repository features.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers a command to be run after the test case completes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the following command should fail.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or verifies Git configuration settings.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_modebits
methods.description: Checks the permission bits of a file or directory.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Introduces a delay or ensures time progression for tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
